annotation.bound_parties_text: The Order binds aircraft operators, registered owners, pilots and crew, holders of licences and certificates, and persons generally in relation to aircraft (including unmanned aircraft), with the CAA as regulator.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: an aircraft must not fly in or over the United Kingdom unless it is registered in—
annotation.dates_quote: This Order may be cited as the Air Navigation Order 2016 and comes into force on 25th August 2016.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Art. 265A omitted (1.1.2026) by virtue of The Unmanned Aircraft (Offences and Consequential Amendments) Regulations 2025 (S.I. 2025/1284)
